outputs.handling: Export continuously; finite storage eventually blocks production.
outputs.name: ice

configuration.boundaryPolicy: Only declared boundary chests/pipes; no direct machine or intermediate injection; drain declared outputs only. Material startup seeds supplied once at dedicated boundary chests.

rateBasis: Physical items/fluids removed only at declared output ports after warmup, less any startup stock. Per-window native statistics or completed crafts of exact recipe-product machines prove production; no theoretical rate is reported as measured.

native.portPolicy: Declared raw boundaries only; no machine inventory or internal pipe writes.

environmentAvailability.scope: Scenario-seeded resource availability only; extraction, logistics from the map and player-join behavior are not production measurements.
environmentAvailability.supersessionReason: Earlier assertions are retained as historical metadata; current availability relies on this loaded-save proof.
